nichtsdestoweniger.es: no obstante, con todo, sin embargo

zukunftsweisend.en: pioneer, with a vision of the future

texto: In order to build a mature persuasive discourse, the author must not ignore the opposite arguments, but incorporate them dialectically by recognizing their partial relevance before reaffirming the priority of his approach: **Zwar bringt die Digitalisierung erhebliche Umstellungen mit sich, allerdings überwiegen die Chancen für den Bildungssektor** (While digitization entails considerable changes, however opportunities for the education sector prevail).

Connective adverbs such as **freilich** (certainly) or **nichtsdestoweniger** (not least, however) allow the adversary to be given a point without weakening his own position: **Kritiker warnen vor den Risiken; nichtsdestoweniger bleibt die Initiative zukunftsweisend**.

filas: Zwar ist es teuer, allerdings lohnt es sich.
Das erfordert Zeit, freilich mit Erfolg.
Es gab Kritik; nichtsdestoweniger handelten wir.

frases.en: While digitization involves considerable changes, opportunities still prevail.

frases.es: Los críticos expresan preocupaciones fundadas; no por ello la reforma deja de ser pionera.
frases.en: Critics express well-founded concerns; reform is therefore no longer a pioneer.

frases.es: Desde luego, hay que comprobar qué medidas benefician realmente a los afectados.
frases.en: Of course, it is necessary to see what measures are actually in the interests of those concerned.
